question: Do dangling branches explain most false-positive mechanical seam edges, while true closed-surface seams survive a graph 2-core?
operator: Iteratively remove predicted seam edges incident to barrier-graph vertices of degree < 2, except vertices incident to an original mesh boundary edge.
rationale: On a closed triangulated surface, a separating seam boundary should form cycles or junction-bearing cores rather than terminate arbitrarily in the interior.
teacher_policy: Teacher source topology is evaluation-only after raw scores and 2-core pruning are frozen.
